import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x="StichtagDat", y="AnzHunde", hue="AlterV10Lang", palette="muted")

# Title and labels
plt.title("Number of Dogs by Date and Age Group")
plt.xlabel("Date")
plt.ylabel("Number of Dogs")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title="Age Group")

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("output.png")
plt.close()
